T: Move it, move it. To the buffet.
D: Four pampered zoo animals from New York end up shipwrecked on Madagascar.
P: Serve the steak when Alex starts seeing his friends as steaks.
S: Sushi rice seasoned with vinegar and sugar, spread on nori, filled with salmon and avocado, rolled tight with a mat, sliced with a wet knife, soy and pickled ginger alongside.
Brownie batter and cheesecake batter swirled into black and white stripes, baked at 170C for 30 minutes.
M: the steak Alex dreams about in the zoo
Rib eye dry-brined overnight, seared hard in a smoking cast iron pan, flipped every minute, pulled at 54C and rested 8 minutes, topped with garlic and parsley butter, with shoestring fries.
the fish Alex finally learns to eat on the island
Onion, ginger and garlic softened, curry spices and tomato cooked down, coconut milk added, snapper pieces simmered gently 6 minutes, finished with lime and coriander. Steamed rice.
W: Thick pineapple wedges grilled until charred, drizzled with a caramel of brown sugar, butter and a splash of dark rum cooked until glossy, with coconut ice cream.
K: the welcome party on the island
Mango nectar and fresh passionfruit pulp topped with lemonade over plenty of ice, a lime wedge on each glass.

s.how: Cook 300g sushi rice and season with vinegar and sugar. Spread over 4 nori sheets, fill with 200g salmon and avocado and roll tight with a mat. Slice with a wet knife. Serve with soy and pickled ginger. Smile and wave, boys.

Melt 150g dark chocolate with 120g butter, whisk in 200g sugar and 2 eggs and fold in 80g flour. Beat 200g cream cheese with 50g sugar and 1 egg. Spread the brownie in a tin and swirl the cheesecake through in stripes. Bake at 170C for 30 minutes.

m.note: the steak Alex dreams about in the zoo
m.how: Dry-brine 4 rib eyes overnight. Sear in a smoking cast iron pan, flipping every minute, and pull at 54C. Rest 8 minutes and top with 60g butter mashed with garlic and parsley. Fry 1kg potatoes cut into shoestrings.

w.how: Cut a pineapple into thick wedges and grill until charred. Melt 60g butter with 80g brown sugar and 2 tbsp dark rum until glossy and pour over. Serve straight away with scoops of coconut ice cream.

d.note: the welcome party on the island
d.how: Mix 500ml mango nectar with the pulp of 3 passionfruit. Pour over plenty of ice in four glasses and top with lemonade. Add a lime wedge to each.
